key_insight: A deep learning model can both detect bowel obstruction on abdominal CT and localize the transition zone, including an interpretable slice-level focus area.
clinical_relevance: This could help radiologists triage scans faster and identify the critical obstruction point more efficiently in high-volume settings.
method: Multi-task deep learning framework for joint obstruction detection and transition zone localization.
Added an interpretable classifier using a probabilistic selection mask to highlight the suspected transition point within a slice.
Evaluated on abdominal CT scans from an internal dataset.
evidence_signal: On 1,427 internal abdominal CTs, the model achieved 93% test accuracy for obstruction detection and 95% Hit@10 for transition zone localization.
watch_item: Results come from an internal dataset, so broader external validation is needed before routine deployment.
paper_title: Bowel Obstruction Detection and Localization on Abdominal CT with Deep Learning
